role: Minister of the Economy, Finance and Industrial, Energy and Digital Sovereignty
organization: Government of France (Lecornu I, then Lecornu II)
description: Appointed Minister of the Economy and Finance in Sebastien Lecornu's first government on 5 October 2025; retained the portfolio (with the expanded title covering industrial, energy and digital sovereignty) in the 26 February 2026 reshuffle forming the Lecornu II government.

organization: Government of France (under Bruno Le Maire; PMs Elisabeth Borne and Gabriel Attal)
description: Minister Delegate for Industry, attached to the Minister of the Economy and Finance. Carried the 2023 Green Industry Law (loi industrie verte).

role: Member of the National Assembly (1st constituency for French residents overseas)
description: Deputy for the first constituency for French residents overseas (Canada and the United States). In office 21 June 2017 to 4 August 2022, then re-elected and in office again from 8 July 2024; his seat was suspended during ministerial service.

role: President of the Economic Affairs Committee
description: Chairman of the Committee on Economic Affairs; served as parliamentary rapporteur on the privatisation of Groupe ADP (Aeroports de Paris).

role: Executive Vice-President and Chief Investment Officer
organization: Caisse de depot et placement du Quebec (CDPQ)
description: Recruited as Executive Vice-President and Chief Investment Officer of CDPQ, one of the world's largest public pension and investment funds, reporting to president Michael Sabia. Left in 2017 to enter French politics.
Held leadership roles in the French financial sector, including at Groupama and Natixis, before moving to Canada in 2009.
